description.sr:
Objekat grupiše više vrednosti pod imenima. Ta imena se zovu svojstva: `{ firstName: 'Ana', age: 20 }` ima svojstva `firstName` i `age`. Vrednost svojstva čitaš tačkom: `person.firstName` daje `'Ana'`. Ako svojstvo ne postoji, rezultat nije greška nego `undefined`, vrednost koja znači „ništa“.

Napiši funkciju `getFullName(person)` koja vraća ime i prezime osobe, a između njih srednje ime ako ga ima.

`person` je objekat sa svojstvima `firstName` i `lastName` (tekstovi, nikad prazni), a može da ima i `middleName`. Funkcija vraća tekst: delovi su razdvojeni jednim razmakom.

Pravila:
- ako `middleName` ne postoji ili je prazan tekst `''`, srednje ime se preskače, bez duplog razmaka
- ostala svojstva objekta (na primer `age`) se ignorišu
- objekat `person` se ne menja

Primeri:
- `getFullName({ firstName: 'Ana', lastName: 'Petrovic' })` → `'Ana Petrovic'`
- `getFullName({ firstName: 'Ana', middleName: 'Maria', lastName: 'Petrovic' })` → `'Ana Maria Petrovic'`
- `getFullName({ firstName: 'Ana', middleName: '', lastName: 'Petrovic' })` → `'Ana Petrovic'`, jer prazno srednje ime ne ostavlja dupli razmak
- `getFullName({ firstName: 'Ana', lastName: 'Petrovic', age: 30 })` → `'Ana Petrovic'`
description.en:
An object groups several values under names. Those names are called properties: `{ firstName: 'Ana', age: 20 }` has the properties `firstName` and `age`. You read the value of a property with a dot: `person.firstName` gives `'Ana'`. If a property does not exist, the result is not an error but `undefined`, a value that means “nothing”.

Write a function `getFullName(person)` that returns the first and last name of a person, with the middle name between them if there is one.

`person` is an object with the properties `firstName` and `lastName` (texts, never empty), and it may also have `middleName`. The function returns a text: the parts are separated by a single space.

Rules:
- if `middleName` does not exist or is an empty text `''`, the middle name is skipped, with no double space
- other properties of the object (for example `age`) are ignored
- the object `person` is not changed

Examples:
- `getFullName({ firstName: 'Ana', lastName: 'Petrovic' })` → `'Ana Petrovic'`
- `getFullName({ firstName: 'Ana', middleName: 'Maria', lastName: 'Petrovic' })` → `'Ana Maria Petrovic'`
- `getFullName({ firstName: 'Ana', middleName: '', lastName: 'Petrovic' })` → `'Ana Petrovic'`, because an empty middle name leaves no double space
- `getFullName({ firstName: 'Ana', lastName: 'Petrovic', age: 30 })` → `'Ana Petrovic'`

text.sr:
Ovde pravimo (deklarišemo) funkciju. Funkcija je imenovan komad koda koji možemo da pozovemo koliko god puta hoćemo, svaki put sa drugim ulazom.

- `function getFullName` pravi funkciju sa tim imenom. Test je poziva baš tim imenom, pa mora biti napisano tačno ovako (velika i mala slova se razlikuju).
- `(person)` je lista parametara. Parametar je prazno „mesto“ za ulaz: `person` je objekat sa podacima o osobi. Poziv `getFullName({ firstName: 'Ana', lastName: 'Petrovic' })` daje `person = { firstName: 'Ana', lastName: 'Petrovic' }`.
- `{` otvara telo funkcije, a zatvara ga `}` u liniji 7.

Sama deklaracija ništa ne računa. Kod iz tela se izvršava tek kad funkciju pozovemo.
text.en:
Here we create (declare) a function. A function is a named piece of code that we can call as many times as we like, each time with different input.

- `function getFullName` creates a function with that name. The test calls it by exactly this name, so it must be spelled exactly like this (letter case matters).
- `(person)` is the parameter list. A parameter is an empty “slot” for input: `person` is an object with the data about a person. The call `getFullName({ firstName: 'Ana', lastName: 'Petrovic' })` gives `person = { firstName: 'Ana', lastName: 'Petrovic' }`.
- `{` opens the function body, and `}` on line 7 closes it.

The declaration itself computes nothing. The code in the body runs only when we call the function.

text.sr:
Počinjemo od imena.

- `person.firstName` čita svojstvo `firstName` objekta `person` (tačka znači „uzmi svojstvo“).
- `let` pravi promenljivu čija se vrednost kasnije menja. Mora `let`, jer ćemo u liniji 4 na `name` nadovezati srednje ime.
text.en:
We start from the first name.

- `person.firstName` reads the property `firstName` of the object `person` (the dot means “take the property”).
- `let` creates a variable whose value changes later. It has to be `let`, because on line 4 we append the middle name to `name`.

text.sr:
Srednje ime dodajemo samo ako ga ima.

- `if (person.middleName)` proverava da li je vrednost „truthy“. Ako svojstvo ne postoji, vrednost je `undefined`, a ako je prazan tekst, vrednost je `''`. Oba su falsy, pa se telo `if`-a preskače. Svaki neprazan tekst je truthy.
- `name += ' ' + person.middleName` je skraćeno od `name = name + ' ' + person.middleName`. Nadovezuje razmak pa srednje ime, pa dobijamo razmak samo kad srednje ime postoji.
- `{` u liniji 3 otvara telo, a `}` u liniji 5 ga zatvara.

```
person                                  middleName   name posle if-a
{ firstName: 'Ana', lastName: ... }     undefined    'Ana'
{ ..., middleName: '', ... }            ''           'Ana'
{ ..., middleName: 'Maria', ... }       'Maria'      'Ana Maria'
```
text.en:
We add the middle name only if there is one.

- `if (person.middleName)` checks whether the value is “truthy”. If the property does not exist, the value is `undefined`, and if it is an empty text, the value is `''`. Both are falsy, so the body of the `if` is skipped. Every non-empty text is truthy.
- `name += ' ' + person.middleName` is short for `name = name + ' ' + person.middleName`. It appends a space and then the middle name, so we get a space only when the middle name exists.
- `{` on line 3 opens the body, and `}` on line 5 closes it.

```
person                                  middleName   name after the if
{ firstName: 'Ana', lastName: ... }     undefined    'Ana'
{ ..., middleName: '', ... }            ''           'Ana'
{ ..., middleName: 'Maria', ... }       'Maria'      'Ana Maria'
```

text.sr:
Dodajemo prezime i vraćamo rezultat.

- `+` između tekstova ih nadovezuje, pa `name + ' ' + person.lastName` daje ime (i srednje ime), razmak i prezime.
- Prezime uvek postoji, pa nema `if`-a. Zato je razmak pre prezimena uvek ispravan.
- `person` smo samo čitali, nikad menjali.
text.en:
We add the last name and return the result.

- `+` between texts joins them, so `name + ' ' + person.lastName` gives the first name (and the middle name), a space and the last name.
- The last name always exists, so there is no `if`. That is why the space before it is always correct.
- We only read `person`, never changed it.

text.sr:
Zatvara telo funkcije otvoreno u liniji 1.

- `}` je par za `{`. Svaka otvorena `{` mora da ima svoju `}`; ako jedna fali, kod se ne može pročitati (`SyntaxError`).
text.en:
Closes the function body opened on line 1.

- `}` is the pair of `{`. Every opened `{` must have its `}`; if one is missing, the code cannot be read (`SyntaxError`).

note.sr: Provera `if (person.middleName)` hvata i `undefined` i prazan tekst odjednom.
note.en: The check `if (person.middleName)` catches both `undefined` and an empty text at once.

Here we create (declare) a function. A function is a named piece of code that we can call as many times as we like, each time with different input.

- `function getFullName` creates a function with that name. The test calls it by exactly this name, so it must be spelled exactly like this (letter case matters).
- `(person)` is the parameter list. A parameter is an empty “slot” for input: `person` is an object with the data about a person. The call `getFullName({ firstName: 'Ana', lastName: 'Petrovic' })` gives `person = { firstName: 'Ana', lastName: 'Petrovic' }`.

text.sr:
Pravimo deo za srednje ime: ili razmak i srednje ime, ili ništa.

- `uslov ? a : b` je ternarni operator: ako je uslov truthy, rezultat je `a`, inače `b`.
- Uslov je `person.middleName`. Ako svojstvo ne postoji (`undefined`) ili je prazan tekst, uslov je falsy i dobijamo `''` (prazan tekst).
- Inače dobijamo `` ` ${person.middleName}` ``: šablon-literal (tekst u kosim apostrofima) u kome `${...}` ubacuje vrednost. Razmak na početku je deo šablona, pa se razmak pojavljuje samo uz srednje ime.

```
middleName   middle
undefined    ''
''           ''
'Maria'      ' Maria'
```
text.en:
We build the middle-name part: either a space and the middle name, or nothing.

- `condition ? a : b` is the ternary operator: if the condition is truthy, the result is `a`, otherwise `b`.
- The condition is `person.middleName`. If the property does not exist (`undefined`) or is an empty text, the condition is falsy and we get `''` (an empty text).
- Otherwise we get `` ` ${person.middleName}` ``: a template literal (text in backticks) in which `${...}` inserts a value. The space at the start is part of the template, so a space appears only with the middle name.

```
middleName   middle
undefined    ''
''           ''
'Maria'      ' Maria'
```

text.sr: Sastavljamo rezultat jednim šablonom: `${person.firstName}` je ime, `${middle}` je srednje ime sa razmakom ispred (ili ništa), zatim razmak i `${person.lastName}`. Rezultat je `'Ana Maria Petrovic'` ili `'Ana Petrovic'`, uvek sa jednim razmakom između delova.
text.en: We build the result with one template: `${person.firstName}` is the first name, `${middle}` is the middle name with a space before it (or nothing), then a space and `${person.lastName}`. The result is `'Ana Maria Petrovic'` or `'Ana Petrovic'`, always with one space between the parts.

text.sr:
Zatvara telo funkcije otvoreno u liniji 1.

- `}` je par za `{`. Svaka otvorena `{` mora da ima svoju `}`; ako jedna fali, kod se ne može pročitati (`SyntaxError`).
text.en:
Closes the function body opened on line 1.

- `}` is the pair of `{`. Every opened `{` must have its `}`; if one is missing, the code cannot be read (`SyntaxError`).

note.sr: Kraće, ali ternarni operator i šablon traže malo više čitanja nego `if`.
note.en: Shorter, but the ternary operator and the template take a little more reading than an `if`.
